issues.description: The visible Tables.do inputs and outputs use project-relative raw/, dta/, and tables/ paths. Set a consistent working directory for the chosen branch and keep these paths resolvable in a working copy.

The Prowess CSR source has repeated native header names, and data_creation.do drops importer fields v53-v57 immediately after import. Confirm the imported position-to-header mapping under the required Stata importer before using this raw-construction route; do not infer that a field is absent or rename columns from their visible labels.

Full reconstruction builds prior-observation lags before retaining year>=2010, while GetTreatment uses 2011-2013. Existing bounded metadata does not establish the required firm/year history for those constructions. This is a full-reconstruction history question; it does not erase the available prepared Tables inputs in analysis_only.

The climate branch requires a firm-year input joined on ISIN/year and uses the base and op_cc/rg_cc/ph_cc measure families. The assigned package inventory contains no compatible climate firm-year source; the prepared ISIN crosswalk is a separate local input and does not replace this dataset.

GetTreatment has a distinct 2011-2013 company-code construction stage, but the approved current view does not establish its exact input file identity. Do not assume that a similarly shaped prepared panel is the same producer; resolve the source-to-generated-panel mapping before closing the event branch.

Event branches require eleven-observation windows and Event1_new also filters on traded-day coverage. Header and first-record metadata do not establish date storage, full event dates, market matches, or firm coverage for those conditions.
Stata, reghdfe, and ftools are available, but the supplied commands also call outreg2 and winsor2, which were not found in the checked ado paths.

actions.description: Set one coherent working directory and resolve the package-relative paths used by the selected program sequence.
steps: For the documented full sequence, start data_creation.do and then Tables.do from a working copy whose raw/, dta/, and tables/ directories resolve as shown in the source.
For analysis_only, start Tables.do from the package working root with the supplied prepared panel and auxiliary inputs at their referenced locations.
validation: Confirm the selected entry point resolves its first required input and output directory before any authorized run.

actions.description: Resolve the supplied raw input contracts and required firm/year history before full Prowess/MCA reconstruction.
steps: Use the existing packaged Prowess CSR, identity, and MCA files; do not request duplicate raw deliveries solely because the full input history was not scanned.
Before the author drop of v53-v57, document how the imported Prowess positions map to repeated native headers under the Stata importer; do not guess renames.
Confirm the MCA CSV headers map to the source's CIN and CSR amount rename, then preserve the author's merge and panel construction sequence.
Check the source periods and firm histories needed to construct prior-observation lags and the 2011-2013 GetTreatment variables.
validation: Verify native input columns and Stata import names, the identity/MCA joins, generated panel fields, and required prior-year and 2011-2013 coverage.

actions.description: Confirm use of the supplied prepared ISIN crosswalk and identify the separate climate firm-year dataset and its field contract.
steps: Ask the package maintainer to confirm the working-copy load step that uses special_test/Climate Measures/isin.dta at the climate merge location while avoiding reliance on an unprovided raw crosswalk.
Obtain the actual separate climate firm-year input or its documented source, identifier/date contract, and all base/op_cc/rg_cc/ph_cc measures; no compatible file is in this package inventory.
validation: Confirm the crosswalk fields match the Prowess-code/ISIN join and the climate source matches ISIN/year plus every consumed climate measure.

actions.description: Preserve the independent EventStudyCode, GetTreatment, and NewNov branches and validate their supplied-input and generated-output handoffs in a working copy.
steps: Keep Event1_B, each event text file, market series, treatment, industry, and Murli inputs as separate products; route each only to the matching event block.
Resolve the GetTreatment input identity from the author-visible path before treating it as the generated main panel; retain the separate 2011-2013 treatment construction.
Keep the Aug29 and AllFirmData outputs, and Treatment_1/Treatment_2 producer-to-consumer order, aligned within the event working directories.
Check co_stkdate storage, market merge coverage, required eleven-observation windows, and the Event1_new traded-day filter for each branch.
validation: Confirm every branch opens its intended supplied or generated input, its date/identifier keys match the corresponding market/treatment file, and each documented window condition is met.

actions.description: Make the two called Stata add-ons available in the selected ado path before an authorized run.
steps: Review and add the required outreg2 and winsor2 ado packages to the Stata environment used for this package.
Do not replace the required commands or change the study's analysis while preparing the runtime.
validation: Use Stata's command lookup to confirm both exact entry points resolve in the active ado path.

review_notes: The analysis_only route has current field-level native proof for all nine Tables inputs. The main panel's meanprofit reference is covered by the native meanprofits field; the leading blank Twitter header is imported as v1 and dropped. Neither naming distinction is treated as a missing field.

The text header projections and one-row package probes establish bounded input readability only. They do not establish full population, historical coverage, date matching, or successful author execution.

Full Prowess reconstruction and the climate and event branches remain separate from the Tables-only route. In particular, the climate firm-year source and GetTreatment source identity remain unresolved.
Tables.do generates twitter_treatment.dta, treatment_A10.dta, and stk.dta before their visible consumer commands; none is requested as an extra raw delivery.
No author program, regression, data reconstruction, or result reproduction was run in this assessment.
